messages:
rohit: Hey team — enterprise prospect asked for BCP/DR details to close the SIG review. They want explicit RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence, failover behavior, and recent test evidence. Can we assemble a short packet?

mira: For SIG/CAIQ we usually provide: RTO, RPO per deployment type, backup retention, encryption in transit/at-rest, and last DR test summary + artifacts. I can draft the control mappings.

sam: Quick numbers we can commit to for Hosted API: RTO = 5 minutes for control-plane failover; RTO = 30s typical for read/replica failover; RPO = <=60s for user-facing state (KV/cache) and near-zero for model artifacts via immutable releases. Backups: nightly DB snapshots + 6-hour incremental replication. Retention: 30 days live snapshots, 365 days cold archives.

devon: For Dedicated/Private customers we document options: warm-standby cross-region replication (RTO ~15m), cold-standby restore (RTO hours), and synchronous replication choices for <1s RPO at cost. Failover path: traffic policy -> region routable -> model variant fallback.

elaine: Prospect specifically asked for: 1) a one-paragraph statement for procurement on SLA/uptime, 2) a CSV with the last three DR test dates + pass/fail + runbook link, and 3) sample restore logs showing timestamps. Can we supply?

mira: SLA statement: "Redwood Inference maintains a 99.95% platform availability SLA for Hosted API with documented maintenance windows; Dedicated offers contractable SLAs per reserved capacity agreement. Multi-region failover and model fallbacks reduce customer-visible downtime; detailed runbooks and RTO/RPO metrics are provided for enterprise reviews." I'll convert into procurement-friendly language.

sam: I can export DR test artifacts. Example restore command we use internally to generate evidence:

```
redwoodctl dr report --since=2025-11-01 --format=csv > dr-tests-2025.csv
redwoodctl backup verify --snapshot=2025-11-18T03:12:00Z --output=restore-log.txt
```

I'll attach the CSV and the restore-log snippet.

devon: Last test summary (to include in CSV): 2025-11-18 PASS — warm-standby failover exercise, median RTO 4m20s; 2025-07-02 PASS — cold-restore validation, RTO 2h10m; 2024-12-09 PASS — cross-region routing failover, RTO 6m. We keep signed runbook checklists for each.

mira: For SIG mapping: map these artifacts to controls CP-2, CP-4, CP-6 (backup and recovery), and SC-13 (cryptographic protections). Note: encrypted snapshots use KMS; HSM-backed key option documented for Private deployments.

rohit: Perfect. Two asks from prospect: can you include screenshots of the runbook checklist filled out, and a redacted restore log (no customer PII)? Also they want an explicit RPO number for embeddings/indices.

sam: Embeddings/index RPO depends on config: default async replication RPO <=60s; with strong consistency replication we can get RPO <5s. We'll provide statements for both and note recommended configs.

mira: I'll prepare a short cover note linking each artifact to the SIG question ID and call out any optional capabilities for Dedicated/Private.

inc-bot: Automated message: DR Test Runner completed artifact bundle generation for thread 1825012345. Files: dr-tests-2025.csv, restore-log-20251118.txt, runbook-checklist-20251118.pdf (redacted).

elaine: Great — I'll upload the bundle to the prospect portal and reply to their questionnaire. Rohit, can you confirm pricing for optional strong-consistency replication?

rohit: On it. Will confirm price delta and include notes that RPO <5s is available as a paid option for Dedicated/Private only.

mira: One more — include a note about scheduled maintenance windows and the maintenance SLA policy. I have the standard wording and will paste it into the packet.

elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble and send by EOD.

sam: Leaving the runbook excerpt here for quick copy: "Step 1: Verify latest snapshot integrity. Step 2: Promote standby region traffic. Step 3: Validate model KV cache warmup. Step 4: Sanity queries and signal rollback if error rate >1%."

devon: If they ask for proof of third-party attestation, point them to our latest SOC2 / ISO excerpt; security already has those artifacts in the sales vault.

rohit: Closing note — I'll track acceptance in the CRM and flag for legal review if they want SLA amendments.

elaine: Thread closed for content prep — thanks all :thumbsup:
